elements.inner_text:
Method Listen
        
          p^=σ ⁣(W h+b)\hat{p} = \sigma\!\big(\mathbf{W}\,\mathbf{h} + b\big)p^​=σ(Wh+b)
          RNA-FM + ESM-2 embeddings → symmetric encoders → sigmoid over latent h
        
        RPIembeddor architecture — dual embeddings → encoders → sigmoid. 1.4M parameters.
      
      
    

    
    
      
        Problem Listen
        Predicting whether an ncRNA and protein interact from sequence alone is largely unsolved: most methods are protein-specific and need a dataset per protein.
        Datasets exist for only a few hundred of the ~2,000 human RNA-binding proteins.
      
      
        Motivation Listen
        
          A sequence-only classifier across diverse RNA and protein types unlocks the vast interaction space without per-protein data.
          Foundation models trained on massive unlabeled corpora inject structural and functional priors that are otherwise unavailable for RNAs at scale.
        
        Meta-learning across interaction types remains largely unexplored.
      
      
        Dataset / Benchmark Listen
        
          From RNAInter (>47M interactions); sequences recovered via NCBI, UniProt and Ensembl and annotated with Rfam and Pfam.
          122,217 interactions (1:2 pos:neg) with realistic negatives, split by RNA family so no family is shared between train and test.
          Splits by family: TRinter 109,214 · TSfam 13,003 · external RPI2825.
        
        
          RNAInterNCBIUniProtEnsembl
          RfamPfam
        
      
    

    
    
      
      
        Key Results Listen
        ROC on held-out TSfam: AUC 0.70 vs 0.48 (XRPI) and 0.50 (IPMiner), which sit at chance. RPIembeddor generalizes to unseen RNA families.
      
      
        Ablation Study Listen
        
          EmbeddingsF1Acc
          Random RNA-FM0.00.624
          Random ESM-20.00.624
          Full (RNA-FM + ESM-2)0.6050.678
        
        Replace either embedding and the model collapses to a negative-only classifier — both are essential.
      
    

    
    
      
        Headline Numbers
        
        
          0.70
          ROC AUC on unseen RNA families
          vs 0.48–0.50 (chance) baselines
          
            0.586F1 on TSfam
            122Kinteractions
            1.4Mmodel params
          
        
      
      
        Takeaway Listen
        Feeding RNA + protein foundation-model embeddings into a compact attention classifier yields the first strong sequence-only predictor that generalizes across unseen RNA families.
        
          First
          A general, sequence-only ncRNA-protein interaction predictor that needs no per-protein training data.
        
        The released RNAInterAct dataset, split to remove homology bias, gives the community a fair benchmark for further progress.

Takeaway Listen
        Feeding RNA + protein foundation-model embeddings into a compact attention classifier yields the first strong sequence-only predictor that generalizes across unseen RNA families.
        
          First
          A general, sequence-only ncRNA-protein interaction predictor that needs no per-protein training data.
        
        The released RNAInterAct dataset, split to remove homology bias, gives the community a fair benchmark for further progress.
